name: dt-managed-mcp
description: Unified MCP server for Dynatrace Managed: read (Settings 2.0, entities, metrics, events, problems, SLOs, RUM, consumption, tokens) + optional write (Settings 2.0 create/update/validate, custom metric ingest, dashboard create/update). The read surface always works; write tools register only when DT_WRITE_TOKEN is set.
